Class Board

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Board
public class Board extends Object
The 8 x 8 grid of squares and the record of captured pieces.

The board stores pieces in a Piece[8][8] array indexed by [row][col] using the mapping documented in Position. An empty square holds null.

The board knows where pieces are but not whose turn it is or whether a move is legal; those decisions belong to Game. The board's invariant is that every non-null grid[r][c] has getPosition() equal to (r, c).

Phase 2 adds what the full rules need from the board: the en passant square, attack detection for check, applyMove(Move) for the special moves, and copy() so a move can be tried on a copy before it is played on the real board (Prototype pattern).

    • enPassantTarget

      private Position enPassantTarget
      The square a pawn skipped over on the previous move by advancing two squares, or null. An enemy pawn may capture en passant by moving onto it, but only on the very next move, so every move resets this.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Clears the board and places all 32 pieces in the standard starting position. White occupies ranks 1-2 and Black occupies ranks 7-8.

    • placeBackRank

      private void placeBackRank(PieceColor color, int row)
      Places the eight back-rank pieces for one color. Order from file A to H: Rook, Knight, Bishop, Queen, King, Bishop, Knight, Rook.
      Parameters:
      color - the color to place
      row - the array row of that color's back rank

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Removes every piece from the board and empties the captured list.

    • copy

      public Board copy()
      Returns a deep copy of this board: every piece is copied, so moves made on the copy never affect this board. Used to test whether a move would leave a king in check, and by the computer opponent to look ahead.
      Returns:
      an independent board in the same position

    • restoreFrom

      public void restoreFrom(Board source)
      Replaces this board's contents with a copy of another board's position, captured pieces, and en passant square.
      Parameters:
      source - the board to copy from; must not be null

    • isPathClear

      public boolean isPathClear(Position from, Position to)
      Checks whether every square strictly between two positions is empty. The endpoints themselves are not examined.

      Only meaningful for moves along a rank, file, or diagonal. Adjacent squares have no squares between them, so the path is trivially clear.

      Parameters:
      from - starting square
      to - ending square
      Returns:
      true if no piece sits between from and to; false if a piece blocks the path or the squares are not on a common line

    • movePiece

      public Piece movePiece(Position from, Position to)
      Moves a piece, assuming the move has already been validated by the caller.

      Steps, in order: record any captured piece, clear the source square, put the moving piece on the destination square, and update the moving piece's own position so the board invariant still holds.

      Parameters:
      from - square of the piece being moved; must be occupied
      to - destination square
      Returns:
      the captured piece, or null if the destination was empty
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if from is empty

    • classify

      public MoveType classify(Move move)
      Works out what kind of move move would be on this board. Call this before applyMove(Move), since applying the move changes the answer.
      Parameters:
      move - a move whose source square is occupied
      Returns:
      castling, en passant, promotion, or normal
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the source square is empty

    • applyMove

      public Piece applyMove(Move move)
      Plays a move that has already been validated, including the extra work special moves need: castling also moves the rook, en passant removes the pawn beside the destination, and promotion replaces the pawn (with a queen if Move.getPromotion() is null). Afterwards the en passant square is updated.
      Parameters:
      move - a legal move for the piece on its source square
      Returns:
      the captured piece, or null if nothing was captured
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the source square is empty

    • isSquareAttacked

      public boolean isSquareAttacked(Position square, PieceColor attacker)

      attacker - the color whose pieces might attack it
      Returns:
      true if at least one such piece attacks the square
